components.semantic_purpose: Freeze the real F.I.R.S.T. and Research relationship used by both workstreams.
components.visitor_role: Primary story immediately beneath the accepted Compass.
components.compass_usage: Headline, relationship explanation, labels, lens narratives, and evidence boundary.
components.full_motion_state: Unchanged content with staged geometric settlement.
components.reduced_motion_state: Unchanged content with direct stepped state changes.
components.static_equivalent: Unchanged content with fixed SVG relationship map.
components.evidence_boundary: Research supports examination and custody; it does not create validation.

components.semantic_purpose: Show F.I.R.S.T. as a connected sequence and Research as a surrounding examination and record relationship.
components.compass_usage: One bounded scene under the headline.
components.full_motion_state: Sequence assembles, Research tether settles, and active meaning receives focus.
components.reduced_motion_state: No continuous movement; direct state settlement and user-triggered focus.
components.static_equivalent: Fixed SVG with the same nodes, ordering, Research boundary, and labels.
components.evidence_boundary: Visual settlement never changes scientific status.

components.semantic_purpose: Keep lens state, motion mode, lifecycle, focus, and receipts identical across lab and Compass prototype.
components.full_motion_state: Visible and document-active render loop only.
components.reduced_motion_state: Direct state updates without continuous semantic travel.
components.evidence_boundary: Runtime cannot alter source content or evidence status.

components.semantic_purpose: Present the accepted Compass unchanged while the new story slice is evaluated below it.
components.compass_usage: Same-origin frame with prototype-only presentation cropping.
components.static_equivalent: Existing accepted Compass fallback behavior plus textual orientation.
components.evidence_boundary: No route, content, or validation authority is transferred to the prototype.
